_about: Card text layout rules, read by BOTH the PC worker (worker/render.py stamps the card with Pillow) and the website (lib/text/layout.ts: Settings live preview + slider ranges). Fractions are of the card width W or height H; sizes are px on a 1080 px wide card and scale with W/1080. The name never wraps: it shrinks to fit maxWidthCenter (centred) or maxWidthSide (left/right). The meaning first shrinks to meaningShrinkFirst of its size on one line, then wraps onto up to meaningMaxLines balanced lines, then shrinks further. The meaning is drawn light (meaningWeight) with meaningTracking em of letter spacing between letters, counted in every width. The text keeps a 10% safe margin from the left, right and top edges (12% at the bottom, above the watermark) in every position (2026-10-19). Change a number here and both sides follow.
